#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<vector<long long>> dp(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j != i) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i][j - 1]) % MOD;
            if (i != 0) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (((i + j) & 1) == 1) {
                ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
